_comment: One place for what testers read on each build: TestFlight's What to Test (tool/testflight.py) and Play's release notes (tool/play_upload.py). Change it with the version in pubspec.yaml; a build whose version is not this one says so in its notes instead of repeating an old release's.
what_to_test: TV and screens: 1. Every Android TV and Google TV can install it now (Play no longer asks for a camera, Bluetooth or GPS). 2. On a TV, settings ask for the manager's PIN with the remote itself: the number buttons, or Up/Down to pick a digit, Right to add, OK to unlock. No on-screen keyboard. 3. A TV shows no Tap member card or Scan your pass buttons (no touch, camera or NFC). 4. The first screen's colours: the one the remote is on grows with a white ring; OK picks it. Phone or tablet as the TV's remote: 5. More (or Settings > Screens and TVs) > Control a screen or TV, choose the TV: arrows, OK, Back, Previous/Next advert, Reload adverts, and Settings after a manager's PIN on the phone.
release_notes: Vesopa Go on your TV: the kitchen board lays tickets out side by side on Android TV and Google TV, and everything works with the remote. Tap a member's phone or watch to find them: Go reads the members' card by NFC.
